race.description: Tradies Race Day 28 Aug 2026 Mdn Plate
race.comment: ACHARNEE (8) returned for her second campaign with a solid on-pace second over 1200m at this track in the heavy (9) going. Fitter now and doesn't have to improve much to take this out on the improving surface. SNITZEL MISS (12) twelve-start Maiden starting to test the patience. Drops in trip and class from a good gate with the senior rider hopping aboard. Can feature prominently. CAVIAR (1) resumes. Gelded over the break after he faded on debut to run fifth over 1250m at Canterbury last June. Back with the two good trials and can play a leading role. GUS THE GREAT (3) resuming. Unlucky not to shed his Maiden tag last prep when finishing in the minor money at all three starts. Fitted with the two solid trials and stays in the mix.
